_doc: Ratchet allowances for the plugin-kernel migration guardrails.
A guardrail fails when the current violation count EXCEEDS its allowance.
Allowances may only be lowered, never raised. Target for every key is 0.
Numbers recorded at P0 (baseline-1.7.0) unless noted. See docs/migration/.
_legacyFeatureKeySurfaces_note: Files that still hardcode the 19 legacy class feature keys. P4 part 1 removed the backend copy by deriving the names from the class row and moving the catalogue into the classroom plugin manifest; the frontend copy goes in P5.
_adoptedTables_note: P3: plugins that own a table still carrying its legacy name (see PluginDataDeclaration.adopted). P4.3b.1: classroom students+classes, economy bank_accounts+stocks+student_stocks. P4.3b.2: dungeon dungeon_runs, gacha pet_dictionary+gacha_pools+student_pets, slg territories+class_resources, battles class_battles, challenge challenge_records+world_bosses. Measured transitional total = 14, every entry renamed to p_<slug>_ by P7 (target 0). Permanently-shared tables (currently `records`) are EXCLUDED from this count and checked separately by G10 - they will never be namespaced to one plugin. NOTE: this went 2 -> 5 -> 14 during P4.3b by design; the ratchet's guard is that it cannot grow beyond the domains actually migrated, which is why every increment is enumerated here by hand.
_routeCollisions_note: METHOD+PATH pairs served by more than one controller file. Invisible to the surface snapshot because it compares sets. P4.3b R1 turned one up; economy's is gone with api/modules/economy. The remaining one is plugins/pet vs api/modules/pet on GET /api/pet/students/:studentId - it needs the pet HTTP surface completed before the legacy module can be deleted (HANDOFF 8.3.1). Target 0.
